subject: Delivery timing options
text: Hi, I'm arranging a delivery for the family gathering and wanted to confirm the drop-off window. The contact suggested 9 a.m., but if your route is busy, an afternoon slot between 2 and 3 p.m. would work just as well. Please let me know which option is easiest for your team, and whether parking restrictions might affect arrival. I can leave access instructions and a spare contact number if needed. Thanks. Best, Sam
